_comment: Duplication baseline. The gate fails on an INCREASE only. Lowering these numbers is welcome and needs no ceremony; raising them needs the written justification a core edit needs. Detectors are not interchangeable and are never compared against each other -- 'tokens' is the built-in type-2 detector, 'jscpd' is the npm one.

Identical 201 source files produce 460 clones/8736 lines with 8871abe and 553 clones/12921 lines with e6d8397; Core production/test/benchmark sources are unchanged from main 7664d55. Migrate detector baseline, not a source-duplication waiver.
